rows.grounds: first-person singular present act of vand
accusative object of worship; fire-deity name
appositional accusative identifying the worshipped object

items.question: Which blazing fire-deity is worshipped in this ritual?
items.inference: The verse worships blazing jātaveda as fire.
uncertainties: jātaveda may denote Agni specifically or fire generally
items.plain_english: I worship the blazing jātaveda, the fire.
